info.name: RozFM Node.js API v1
info.description:
Mobile app Node.js / Express API for RozFM.

**Setup**
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Collection variable `base_url` is pre-set to `http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1`.
3. Run **Auth → Register** or **Auth → Login (Phone)** followed by **Auth → Verify OTP** (Demo OTP: `123456`). Token will automatically save to `{{token}}`.
4. All authenticated requests use `Bearer {{token}}`.

**Response shape:** `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`
